source.commit_body:
Score-stage gradient dampener targeting the v36/v37 wadj-neg miss residue
at 70-74 (z=+9.2, miss 52.7%, N=1537/5y).  CWCF gates on overall>=75 and
left this zone untreated; CWWD covers it with a 2D gradient (no hard
threshold) on (wadj, stoch).

Mechanism:
  if 70 <= overall < 75 and wadj < 0:
      stoch_grad = clip((stoch - 25) / 35, 0, 1)
      wadj_grad  = clip(-wadj / 5, 0, 1)
      weakness   = stoch_grad * wadj_grad
      overall   -= 0.95 * weakness * (overall - 55)

Calibration via fast_variant_runner Bayesian sweep
(experiments/cwwd_v38/sweep.py, 14 variants on v37 5y).  All variants
soft-passed the new sub-75 H1 gate; selected variant maximizes 70+
TP improvement while preserving zero spillover to higher tiers.

Per-trade gate (sub-75 H1 fix per assessment-backtest.md):
  - 70+ TP%: 58.9% -> 59.5% (+0.62pp)
  - 70+ N: -4.6% (filtered the bad-quality cohort)
  - 75+/80+/85+/90+/95+: byte-identical (zero spillover)
  - Puts: byte-identical (gate is calls-only)
  - Multi-window: 1y +0.62 / 3y +0.74 / 5y +0.62 (sign-consistent)

Retires WEAK_WEEKLY_CALL_DROP cascade-stage filter (shipped 2026-05-05,
1 day live).  Score-stage encoding fixes the dashboard divergence
problem: a 73 wadj-neg call now drifts below 70 in the score itself,
so it neither shows on the dashboard as a call signal nor enters the
cascade.  Single source of truth.

Also fixes H1-H5 ship gate to handle sub-75 changes — the original
gate measured only {95+, 90+, 85+, 80+, 75+} which has a blind spot
for changes targeting signals already inside the cascade but below
75.  New gate adds 70+ as the affected-tier metric for sub-75
changes; updated assessment-backtest.md.

Frontend: removed the WEAK_WEEKLY_CALL_DROP SkipBadge (filter retired,
no API will emit that reason).  EARN_SUPP_PUT badge stays until v39
ships its score-stage replacement (PESS).
